finding: Exact inner and outer Euclidean extremal ellipsoids, the unique global ellipsoid-volume-ratio minimizer, a sharp Löwner contact transition, and three distinct geometric optimizers.
object: Symmetric unit-sphere triaugmented triangular prisms with nine vertices and 1/2<r<1.
scientific_integrity: Algebraic proof and actual standalone finite checks reported separately; finite tests are not treated as proof of all parameter values.
scientific_limitations: No nonsymmetric nine-vertex case is treated.
The degenerate/combinatorially different endpoint r=1/2 and collapsed r=1 are excluded.
The previously known polytope-volume optimum is attributed to the 2026 source.
Historical priority is provisional; no independent audit was performed.
title: Exact John–Löwner ellipsoids and three distinct optima in a nine-vertex spherical prism family
